issue_context.title: convert options minute data into daily format
issue_context.body:
Guys, this is my first stab at volunteering to help out here, so go easy on me!  :)   I was recommended to work on converting the options minute data into a daily format.  Problem also described here:  
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues/941

#### Expected Behavior
I do need help to make sure I fully understand the requirements.  I think what I need to do is the following:  

Create a standalone application in the Toolbox project that takes all minute data available in a given directory, loop over the entire directory of securities,  for each security: group by day and strike to build day bars from the minute bars.  If I take GOOG as an example: https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/tree/master/Data/option/usa/minute/goog

I see there are 3 file types there 

20151224_openinterest_american.zip	
20151224_quote_american.zip	
20151224_trade_american.zip

For quote, I think the the group by and aggregation logic are as follows:  

high - take max of day
low - take low of day
close - last minute bar close
volume - sum volume
open interest - last volume minute bar 

I need help understanding where I can find the layouts for these files, I thought it was in OptionChain.cs but I dont see it there.   Also, the rest of the logic
